overview.description: The MAX Airlines - 3X Inverse Leveraged ETNs (JETD) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Prime Airlines index. The fund tracks -3x the daily price movements of an index consisting of US-listed companies in the air transportation industry, these include airlines, airfreight and logistics, and aircraft and parts manufacturing. The index selects equities by market cap and weights the resulting portfolio by liquidity. JETD was launched on Jun 23, 2023 and is issued by Max.
